title: TALKS AND WORKSHOPS | Bright Futures 4 All
text:
Explore workshops that foster learning and inspiration

We offer a variety of engaging workshops and have hosted thought-provoking sessions, including:

Closing The Loop - In Partnership with: The GLA & Koreo

Eating Well For Less - In Partnership with: Henry

SEND Awareness Workshop - At Southside Leadership Youth Academy

Neuro-diversity Project Talks & Expo Conference - Supporting Neurodiverse Individuals in Education and Workplace Settings

I Mean Business - Business Networking Event for Females

Book our CEO Mrs. Karen Bryson, to deliver an engaging and impactful keynote speech at your upcoming events or workshops. With her extensive expertise and status as a thought leader in the SEND community, She is deeply passionate about the importance of providing quality education to all children. She is available to speak on a wide range of topics, ensuring that her presentation resonates with your audience and leaves them feeling inspired and informed. Don’t miss the chance to have Mrs. Bryson share her insights and vision at your next event!

We Enhance Learning Potential

Attending this group provided a safe and supportive space to connect with other parents navigating the challenges of raising children with SEND and or neurodiversity. While we were all at different stages of this journey, participating in the fact-finding group helped me feel less isolated and more hopeful, knowing that I am not alone and that someone has taken up the mantle by listening to us and taking our voices forward.

Speaking in the focus group made me feel empowered, by sharing my experiences I hope to influence change. While we are in a settled place now, my son is still young, and there’s a long way to go. I want to make things easier for him in the future and also support other parents and children who, like we once were, feel overwhelmed and are seeking support and guidance.
